behavior-patch.summary: Canonical FrontendApp communication separates commands from events and uses Message only as their transport-neutral abstraction.

requirement.statement: Canonical FrontendApp halfcode SHALL model a requested operation as a Command and a completed fact as an Event. A Command MAY reference a runtime-first handler and config; an Event SHALL NOT declare a handler. Message denotes either concrete protocol kind only in generic transport and policy positions.

case.given: a Command with a handler code reference and static config
case.then: the handler SHALL receive runtime as its first argument according to output = fn(runtime, input, config)
a handler field SHALL be rejected because event delivery is not a request handler declaration

requirement.statement: Canonical FrontendApp XNL SHALL use Commands/Command, Events/Event, commands://, events://, element command, MessagePolicy/MessageRule, contract Sends, and Wire message. Retired Intent vocabulary SHALL receive a focused diagnostic instead of becoming a canonical alias.

case.given: a FrontendApp page with commands.xnl and events.xnl
case.then: both domain schemes and their typed declarations SHALL resolve

case.given: a FrontendApp canonical bundle containing Intents, Intent, or intents://

requirement.statement: Scopes SHALL assemble command/event registries and an optional MessagePolicy into their runtime instance. Contracts SHALL describe accepted and sent message refs. A Wire SHALL deliver one unchanged message ref from a sending route to an accepting route; conversion to another command or event belongs in runtime code.

case.given: a source Page that sends events://#report.saved and a target Page that accepts that exact event
case.then: the resulting WirePlanBinding SHALL carry that events:// ref as message
